edition: Diplomatic transcription and parallel Tibetan alignment based on Kathmandu, Kaiser Library MS 110 (fol. 290r) and Derge Tanjur D 3305 (fol. 230b3–230b6). Unpublished e-text, Kolozsvár, 2025.

title: Kriyāsamuccaya (Vāstunāgaparīkṣāvidhi)
author: Jagaddarpaṇa
edition: Mori, Shun'e (2003). 'Kriyāsamuccaya ni okeru vāstunāga kentei' [The Examination of the Vāstunāga in the Kriyāsamuccaya], Journal of Indian and Buddhist Studies (Indogaku Bukkyōgaku Kenkyū) 52(1): 166–164 [Japanese pagination counted in reverse: pp. (27)–(29)].

title: Kriyāsamuccaya (Ākāśasūtrapātana)
author: Jagaddarpaṇa
edition: Unpublished critical transcription and alignment based on Kathmandu, Kaiser Library MS 110, collated with the facsimile edition by Lokesh Chandra (Śata-Piṭaka Series 237, New Delhi, 1977, p. 90), parallels in Abhayākaragupta's Vajrāvalī, and the Tibetan translation in the Derge Tanjur (Toh 3305, rgyud, ku, 84b3–85a1).

title: Kriyāsamuccaya (mūlāpatti and sthūlāpatti section)
author: Jagaddarpaṇa
edition: Diplomatic transcription and edition based on Kathmandu Kaiser Library MS 110 (siglum C) alongside the Tibetan translation from the Derge Tengyur (D 3305, fol. 207b–208b).

title: Kriyāsamuccaya (Ārāmādipratiṣṭhā section)
author: Jagaddarpaṇa
edition: Unpublished transcription and collation (Kolozsvár, 5 July 2025) based on Nepalese manuscript witness(es) (e.g. C = Kaiser Library MS 110 / Vajrāvalī-Kriyāsamuccaya materials) aligned with the Tibetan translation (Derge Tengyur D 3305).

title: Kriyāsamuccaya (Āyudhalakṣaṇavidhi)
author: Jagaddarpaṇa
edition: Unpublished critical transcription and Tibetan collation, based on Kaiser Library (Kathmandu) MS 110, Kyoto University MS 7, and Degé Tanjur Toh 3305, fols. 238a4–239a5.

title: Kriyāsamuccaya (Śalyoddharaṇa)
author: Jagaddarpaṇa
edition: Diplomatic transcription and synoptic Sanskrit-Tibetan edition based on Kathmandu, Kaiser Library MS 110 and the Derge Tanjur (D 3305).

title: Kriyāsamuccaya (Śiṣyasaṃgrahavidhi)
author: Jagaddarpaṇa
edition: Unpublished critical transcription / working edition (Kolozsvár, 2025), based on Kathmandu Kaiser Library MS 110, supplemented from Lokesh Chandra's facsimile reproduction (1977) and Abhayākaragupta's Vajrāvalī, aligned with Degé Tanjur D 3305.

title: Kriyāsamuccaya (excerpt)
author: Jagaddarpaṇa
edition: Diplomatic transcription and collation based on Kaiser Library (Kathmandu) MS 110, fols. 313v–315r, and Degé Tengyur D 3305, rgyud, dzi 245b6–246b4 (unpublished e-text, Kolozsvár, 7 July 2025).

title: Gaṇapatitattva
edition: Gaṇapati-tattwa, an Old Javanese philosophic text, critically edited, annotated and translated by Mrs. Dr. Sudarshana Devi Singhal, New Delhi: International Academy of Indian Culture, 1958 (Śata-Piṭaka Series, vol. 4; Dvīpāntara-Piṭaka, vol. 3).

title: Saṅ Hyaṅ Kamahāyānikan
